title: Playing at Preservation Hall with Sheik, Kid Thomas and Percy
summary: He has played at Preservation Hall six years, starting with Sheik, then with Kid Thomas and Percy, and Billie and De De Pierce when ill.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: How long have you been playing at Preservation Hall?
Well, who did you play with first then?

I started there with Sheik. Yeah. And then you started... Sheik I went to work with Kit Thomas, from Kit Thomas to Percy. From, now I was in Prince Band before I went with him, Percy Band. I started with Percy.
Now you're playing with Thomas and who else?
I play with Billy and Dee Dee when he was sick.
Yeah, you're playing Billy's playing. Yeah. And who else you play with?
Yeah, on one Sheik plays. On the rare occasions that Sheik plays there, yeah. And that's about all you do now. That's all. Do you work steady every day? I mean, aw.
No, no. Nobody hires you at this age steady.
But I mean, do you get a fair amount of work, enough to live on? Enough to live on, yeah. Keep you in beer and stuff. Yeah. Where are you living now, Singh?
